text: For a representation $V$ of $G$, the character value at the identity, $\chi_V(e)$, equals:
choices: $\dim V$, the degree of the representation
explanation: Since $\rho(e)$ is the identity operator, $\chi_V(e)=\mathrm{tr}(\mathrm{id}_V)=\dim V$. It equals $1$ only for $1$-dimensional representations; $|G|$ is the dimension of the regular representation, not a general character value; and $0$ contradicts $\mathrm{tr}(\mathrm{id})=\dim V>0$.
